lastCompletedStory.title: Migrate test/*.test.ts to the helper via a committed codemod

nextStoryContext: scripts/codemod-test-tmpdir.ts is committed and unit-pinned (test/codemod-test-tmpdir.test.ts, 15 tests): it exports a pure transformTestTmpdirSource(source, importSpecifier) recognizing the sync mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix)) form, the awaited mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), prefix)) form, and the bare join(tmpdir(), ...rest) path-join form, rewriting each to createTestTmpdir(...) (US-002 helper) and pruning now-unused node:os/node:fs/node:fs/promises imports (dropping the whole import statement, or just the identifier if siblings remain used), inserting the helper import at the node:os import's former position (or after the leading import block if no node:os import existed). It also exports computeHelperImportSpecifier(repoRelativeFilePath) to compute the right relative import path. CLI entrypoint: `bun scripts/codemod-test-tmpdir.ts <file> [<file> ...]`, idempotent (a second pass is always changed:false). All 35 top-level test/*.test.ts files that rooted a temp dir in the OS temp dir are now migrated (AC1 grep is clean); no top-level test/*.test.ts file remains as a rooting site. GOTCHA discovered mid-story (now fixed and documented in patterns.md): Bun.spawnSync does NOT live-inherit a process.env mutation made after process startup unless `env: process.env` is passed explicitly -- scripts/validate-agents-md.ts's makeGetTrackedFiles/makeIsIgnored needed this fix because the migrated test/validate-agents-md.test.ts now sets GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES at runtime via the helper. Any future migration story (US-004..US-007) whose touched test file exercises a spawned git call through production code needs the same env:process.env re-check per file touched -- grep the target file's production call sites for `Bun.spawnSync(['git'` / `Bun.spawn(['git'` without an `env` option before assuming GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES coverage is automatic. Remaining rooting sites (per PRD, likely test/supervisor/**, test/fixtures/**, or other nested test dirs) are out of scope for US-003 (top-level test/*.test.ts only, no glob change) and belong to a later story in this PRD.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun's own spawn docs page does not explicitly document env-inheritance semantics (whether omitting `env` inherits a live vs. snapshotted process.env). The fix (env: process.env) is confirmed by direct empirical repro (git ls-files from a GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES-fenced scratch dir: exit 0 without env forwarding, exit 128 with it, matching a shell control), documented in patterns.md; no doc statement contradicts the fix.
